A discovery @latest lookup is not a compatible selection or install instruction; apply no unresolved placeholders or unversioned/floating latest go get. The later hypothetical v0.44.0 bridge publication must not change the preflight chosen set. Preserve the absent toolchain directive and the operator-constrained existing graph; do not install unrelated grpc/Gin/chi/logger bridges. Record exact fictional selections in this report and any eventual app lock, not as fixed future shipped skill recipes. Give concrete future acceptance for each supplied normal/opt-out/log-failure case. Normal generated profile must set OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp and resolve the supplied55318 /v1/logs route with http/protobuf, preserving trace/metric routes; choose exactly one official slog bridge, shared resource LoggerProvider and batch export alongside the actual original local sink. For the real successful PUT warning require actual safe body runtime request completed, WARN, operation put, service go-kvstore and trace/span IDs matching its own HTTP span, plus a span and metric datapoints and one native LogRecord per call. Distinguish native LogRecords from stdout correlation. Preserve original standard log writer/prefix/flags and slog output without invented file handlers or recursion/duplicate export. Plan redaction/bounds and final runtime shutdown completed warning before owned batch shutdown once; do not invent request correlation on the shutdown warning outside an active span. Explicit none opt-out retains original warnings and trace/metrics with zero OTLP logs. Wrong55319 endpoint, grpc with an HTTP-only checked exporter, and log-constructor failure must remain individual log gaps/diagnostic cases, preserving trace/metric startup and original sink. Do not convert failure into an unrequested persisted none default, change the app response, silently choose another endpoint/protocol or leak diagnostic configuration/error text. Logs remain local with no cloud log exporter/credential/forwarding. All future import/solver/test/wire/Studio assertions remain unexecuted; fixture source/API/policy facts do not establish those outcomes. Work through files and safe terminal reads only; no browsers/Computer Use/UI/network calls. Save the Markdown without opening tabs.
